focus: authorize parent and child incident records embedded in detail responses
change: getIncidentDetail now applies the existing canViewIncident predicate to each related parent and child before embedding it. Hidden parents become null and hidden children are omitted; selected-incident authorization and other detail fields remain unchanged.

checks.name: service-regression

limits: The regression compiles staged lib sources and exercises the exported getIncidentDetail with a disposable JSON store; it does not use the canonical data directory.
